title: I built a fighter jet game with Gpt6 Astra
author: Nearby-Heart9774
selftext:
Astra is awesome!

I built it under an hour using the Ultra mode, it was able to source all of the 3D models and build all the environment from a few images

I built **WarLightning**, a browser-based fighter jet combat game.

You can:

* Fly different fighter jets
* Dogfight AI aircraft
* Fire air-to-air missiles
* Bomb ground targets
* Fly around large maps
* Choose aircraft from a hangar

It's still very much in development, and I'm trying to figure out what needs the most work next.

**Play it here:** [https://www.warlightning.com/](https://www.warlightning.com/)
